title: EDGEOPS production readiness

items.title: Approved scope and architecture
items.description: Define supported equipment, users, sites, operating conditions, features, system boundaries and responsible owners. Resolve conflicting active specifications.
items.evidence_required: Approved requirements, architecture decisions, measurable acceptance criteria and an owner for every requirement.
items.current_boundary: Design baseline exists; deployment scope and acceptance are unapproved.

items.title: Verified physical hardware
items.description: Reconcile all 30 hardware categories with actual purchased parts, exact models, ratings, wiring, mounting, protection and installation records. Record conditional components, instruments and spares separately.
items.evidence_required: Verified inventory, final diagrams, photographs, inspection records and qualified physical-safety acceptance.
items.current_boundary: The 30-category catalog is a plan; receipt, installation and commissioning are unverified.

items.title: Reliable sensor acquisition
items.description: Acquire real acceleration, temperature, current and voltage measurements. Verify calibration, units, sampling rate, timing, sensor faults, clipping and missing readings.
items.evidence_required: Repeatable real capture logs and calibration/quality results. Invalid readings remain unavailable rather than becoming misleading zeros.
items.current_boundary: Firmware/reference source exists; dashboard measurements remain synthetic.

items.title: Device and asset identity
items.description: Register every device, sensor, gateway and monitored asset. Track firmware, configuration, boot identity, replacement history and approved assignments.
items.evidence_required: Enrollment and replacement tests proving that observations belong to the correct physical equipment.
items.current_boundary: Device and asset commissioning is not established.

items.title: Durable edge-to-server delivery
items.description: Implement persistent buffering, automatic retries, duplicate handling, content-conflict detection, bounded storage and recovery. Distinguish broker acceptance, edge persistence and central commit.
items.evidence_required: Crash, restart, connection-loss, lost-response, disk-full, overflow, replay and reconciliation results.
items.current_boundary: Scoped laboratory evidence does not establish the complete durable live path.

items.title: Production backend and storage
items.description: Connect authoritative APIs to durable operational records. Implement validated contracts, migrations, transactions, indexing, retention and controlled file/model storage. Preserve existing records during migration.
items.evidence_required: API and concurrency tests, migration reconciliation, capacity measurements and rollback evidence.
items.current_boundary: Local SQLite services work for reports and synthetic planning; central operational storage is unfinished.

items.title: Production identity and security
items.description: Implement account provisioning, least privilege, privileged-account protection, session revocation, device credentials, encrypted transport, secret management and credential rotation.
items.evidence_required: Unauthorized and cross-asset/site tests, expired/revoked credential tests, role-change tests and reviewed security findings.
items.current_boundary: Local sessions/CSRF and scoped tests work; enterprise identity and production security acceptance remain open.

items.title: Fully connected dashboard
items.description: Connect fleet, assets, telemetry, devices, incidents, maintenance, models, reports and audit to authoritative services. Distinguish measured, simulated, replayed, stale, partial and unavailable data.
items.evidence_required: Real-user task completion, permission checks, accessible controls/text, responsive browser tests and correct exports.
items.current_boundary: The UI works with several real local APIs; equipment and several operational services remain simulated or unconnected.

items.title: Operational incident management
items.description: Implement creation, correlation, deduplication, assignment, acknowledgment, investigation, suppression with expiry, escalation, resolution, reopening and closure.
items.evidence_required: Real observation-to-incident traces; duplicate and out-of-order inputs do not repeat operational effects.
items.current_boundary: Current incident examples are browser demonstrations.

items.title: Complete maintenance workflow
items.description: Extend local planning to approved operational requests, technician assignment, execution evidence, independent verification and closure. Bind decisions to exact revisions and separate responsibilities.
items.evidence_required: A complete real case through verified closure; self, stale, concurrent and revoked approvals are correctly denied.
items.current_boundary: Persistent synthetic planning and independent-account review work; field execution is unavailable.

items.title: Validated predictive models
items.description: Obtain representative real operating data and credible labels. Prevent leakage, compare against a baseline, agree performance thresholds and document unsupported conditions.
items.evidence_required: Independent real-recording evaluation, precision/recall, false-alarm results, uncertainty and reviewed model cards. Synthetic scores alone are insufficient.
items.current_boundary: Current comparisons use synthetic labels and are not field-performance evidence.

items.title: Controlled edge model deployment
items.description: Version features and model artifacts. Verify compatibility, runtime parity, resource use, inference timing, staged promotion, monitoring and rollback.
items.evidence_required: Measured gateway results, approved release records and incompatible/corrupt-model plus rollback tests.
items.current_boundary: No production model is active. Offline report approval cannot deploy a model.

items.title: Grounded AI assistance
items.description: For every promised AI capability, connect approved knowledge revisions with access restrictions, citations, uncertainty, abstention and human-reviewed proposals.
items.evidence_required: Retrieval/access, unsupported-answer and injection tests; generated advice cannot grant permissions or bypass approval.
items.current_boundary: The knowledge catalog is a design reference; retrieval/generation is unconnected.

items.title: Reproducible deployment
items.description: Establish controlled environments, pinned dependencies, release artifacts, configuration management, automated checks, secure deployment and migration procedures.
items.evidence_required: Repeatable clean installation, upgrades, failed-upgrade handling and successful rollback.
items.current_boundary: Passing GitHub workflows verify scoped software behavior, not production deployment.

items.title: Monitoring and operational support
items.description: Monitor service health, sensor freshness, delivery lag, queues, resources, storage growth, model behavior and notification delivery. Assign support/escalation owners.
items.evidence_required: Agreed targets met under realistic load and a supervised soak, with actionable alerts and response procedures.
items.current_boundary: Local API checks are not a complete production monitoring or support system.

items.title: Backup and disaster recovery
items.description: Back up operational data, identity configuration, knowledge revisions, models and required configuration. Define acceptable data loss and restoration time.
items.evidence_required: A clean restoration reconciles accounts, permissions, records, artifact references and pending deliveries within agreed targets.
items.current_boundary: Local protective backups exist; full disaster-recovery acceptance is outstanding.

items.title: Data and knowledge governance
items.description: Establish ownership, permitted use, retention, exports, access restrictions and rights to datasets and operating documents.
items.evidence_required: Approved policies and tested enforcement appropriate to the deployment.
items.current_boundary: Policies and document rights require deployment-specific approval.

items.title: Final release acceptance
items.description: Close blocking defects, document limitations, train operators, assign ongoing maintenance and accept an exact release within a defined deployment scope.
items.evidence_required: Dated acceptance from responsible engineering, physical-safety, security and operations reviewers.
items.current_boundary: No final production acceptance or physical sign-off is established.

items.title: Real measurement journey

items.evidence_required: Dated real-deployment test procedure, conditions, observed results, logs/traces, exceptions and responsible reviewer.
items.current_boundary: A scoped software test or synthetic fixture does not automatically pass this deployed-system demonstration.

hardware_rule: Account for all 30 hardware categories. Install conditional parts only where the reviewed design requires them; instruments and spares retain commissioning or replacement roles.
completion_rule: Production acceptance requires a real deployed scope, satisfied mandatory requirements, failure/recovery evidence, no blocking defects and dated qualified review. Recorded reviews in this local register are not physical commissioning or automatic production authorization.
priorities: Validated deployed models and grounded advice
